Paychex Flex Payroll Services: Payroll Processing Made Easy

Paychex Flex Payroll Services pairs powerful technology with expert support. Together, they simplify payroll processing, improve accuracy, and help businesses stay compliant. This video covers customizable payroll workflows and reporting. It also covers data analytics to help support smarter decision-making. You'll see employee-focused tools like Paychex Pre-Check, self-service access, mobile options, flexible pay, and on-demand wages. The video also touches on tax administration, compliance support, and data security. All of it backed by more than 50 years of payroll expertise.

Topics:

  • 0:00 – Paychex Payroll Services Overview
  • 0:12 – Customizable Payroll Data Entry
  • 0:30 – Reports and Data Analytics
  • 0:48 – Employee Pre-Check and Self Service
  • 0:58 – Flexible Pay and Mobile Access
  • 1:28 – Tax Filing and Compliance Management

Paychex Payroll Services Overview

0:03 Get the right combination of online control and personal support with payroll services from Paychex.

0:10 Is your payroll a steady ship with few surprises' week to week?

Customizable Payroll Data Entry

0:14 If so, complete a standard payroll in as few as two clicks. If it's more complex, customize your grid, layout, and filters for easy data entry.

0:28 You're in control from how you enter your data to how you view it.

Reports and Data Analytics

0:34 With more than one hundred and sixty standard reports and analytics, customize your visualizations to uncover trends and make data driven decisions for your business.

0:45 We understand that the payroll process doesn't stop with you. Your employees want to feel valued.

Employee Pre-Check and Self Service

0:52 Paychex Pre-Check allows your employees to review their earnings and report an issue if needed before the payroll run.

Flexible Pay and Mobile Access

1:00 And when it comes to payday, you can offer flexible pay options such as direct deposit, pay cards, paper checks, and even on-demand access to earned wages. Employees can complete self-service actions from our free Paychex Flex mobile app, like making personal changes, updating tax information, and reviewing check stubs and W-2s. You can even complete payroll on the go.

1:26 Processing payroll is more than just cutting checks.

Tax Filing and Compliance Management

1:29 It includes state and federal compliance, data security, tax filing, and more. Paychex will calculate, pay, and file your payroll taxes with the appropriate agencies to provide peace of mind and reduce your risk of penalties for late or inaccurate payments.

1:49 And when you need answers to even the smallest question, we are only a call, click, or swipe away.

1:56 With over fifty years of reliable, industry-leading experience and proven technology to safeguard your data, Paychex can help streamline your payroll processing needs. To learn more about Paychex Flex, contact us today.

Streamline Payroll With Paychex Flex

Simplify payroll processing, tax filing, employee management, and compliance with Paychex payroll solutions.
